Ultimate ASI Loader 9.7.4 x64, ThirteenAG.

Official release: https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader/releases/tag/v9.7.4

The official dinput8.dll is redistributed byte-for-byte, renamed winhttp.dll.
It matches the loader installed during the author's tests. Renaming selects the
loader's supported WinHTTP proxy behavior. License: MIT, see LICENSE.txt.
Archive and DLL SHA-256 pins are in release.json. No loader is built by this project.
